map.表达式求值前先做符号归一：× 换为 *、÷ 换为 /、全角减号换为 -，^ 按幂: Before evaluating, the expression is normalized: × becomes *, ÷ becomes /, full-width minus becomes -, and ^ is parsed as exponentiation; in degree mode trigonometric functions are computed as sin/cos/tan(angle × π ÷ 180), while radian mode calls them directly; log uses log10, ln the natural logarithm and sqrt the square root, with PI and E as constants. Evaluation is performed by a restricted recursive-descent parser that only allows the four basic operations, parentheses, powers, percent signs and whitelisted functions/constants; variables, assignments, property access (such as Math.sin) or arbitrary function names are not supported and produce an expression error. A non-numeric or non-finite result is treated as an expression error; history keeps at most 50 entries, discarding the oldest when exceeded
